evals.name: branded-pitch-deck
evals.prompt: Create a 5-slide pitch deck called monty-claw-pitch.pptx for 'Monty Claw', an AI pair-programming assistant. Slides: title, the problem (devs lose hours on boilerplate), the solution (agentic code generation), traction (2k users in 3 months, 40% weekly growth), and a closing call-to-action. Make it visually polished with illustrations.
evals.expected_output: A .pptx using the brand red/orange/blue theme, the cat logo on the title slide, at least one codex-generated on-brand illustration, no large empty regions on any slide.
assertions: Deck has exactly 5 slides and passes validate.py with no errors
The brand cat logo (assets/page-logos.jpg) is embedded in the deck's media
Brand palette colors (D74248 / FA8832 / 4DBCD8) are used in the slide XML
At least one generated illustration image (a PNG that is not the logo) is embedded in the deck
No slide has a large empty region (dead zone taller/wider than ~2 inches) in the rendered images
No text overflow, cutoff, or overlapping elements in the rendered images

evals.name: process-diagram-deck
evals.prompt: Make me a short presentation (ci-overview.pptx, 4 slides) explaining our CI/CD pipeline for new engineers: overview, the three stages (build, test, deploy), common failure points, and where to get help. Include a diagram of the pipeline.
evals.expected_output: A .pptx where the pipeline diagram uses real text labels (shapes or shape-overlaid art, not misspelled generated text), on-brand theme, slides filled without dead zones.
assertions: Deck has exactly 4 slides and passes validate.py with no errors
Pipeline stage labels (Build, Test, Deploy) are extractable as real text via markitdown, not baked into an image
Brand palette colors (D74248 / FA8832 / 4DBCD8) are used in the slide XML
No slide has a large empty region (dead zone taller/wider than ~2 inches) in the rendered images
No text overflow, cutoff, or overlapping elements in the rendered images
